oneLine: La Caisse sells big stake in Maple Highways to MAM.

sources.title: La Caisse Sells Big Stake in India's Maple Highways to MAM

synopsis: Australian asset manager Macquarie has completed a $450-million, approximately Rs 4,300 crore transaction to acquire a significant stake in Maple Infrastructure Trust from Canadian pension fund La Caisse. Macquarie Asset Management, acting through its Macquarie Asia-Pacific Infrastructure Fund 4, acquired 37.5% of the units in the infrastructure investment trust, reducing La Caisse's holding to 37.5% from 75%. The transaction also involved Macquarie buying a 42.5% stake in the InvIT's investment manager and a 40% stake in the project manager. As part of the deal, Macquarie has committed $450 million in total, which includes $150 million of fresh equity for future acquisitions, while La Caisse has pledged an additional $150 million to support the platform's next growth phase.
